understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement used directional actions in 3-pixel grid-cell increments, with the selected piece moving unless blocked or affected by an obstacle. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed along with the piece, while walls and boundaries could prevent or alter movement. CLICK selected another piece using its pixel/grid coordinate, and movement hints were only heuristic, so actions sometimes needed to be tested directly.
